== Summary ==
Top 8 players [[Joe Olson]] (left, glasses, blue Outrider Cup hoodie), [[Tom Haid]] (centre, black Japanese-text T-shirt) and [[Barry Alperstein]] (right, plaid shirt, grey neck gaiter) gathered around the time of the Top 8 photo. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

'''Identification:''' Identified by matching [[:File:2021 World Championship Top 8.jpg]] (taken by the same camera minutes earlier; wrap-up caption): clothing and faces match Olson, Haid and Alperstein. The left player is Olson, not [[Greg Shaw]]: both wore the same Outrider Cup 2019 hoodie, but Olson has red hair and glasses and Shaw dark hair and no glasses. The players in the background are not identified.
